description: Independent model seeds 5–9, trained on all 16 tasks. Flat 12-atom featurizer fitted only on primitive+AND queries. Beta=.3 output fidelity and gamma=.1 finite-edit fidelity were fixed from exploratory seeds 0–4 before seeing these seeds. Same <=5% seen-query validation reconstruction gate; XOR entirely absent from featurizer fitting and checkpoint selection. Uniform and shifted-token tests, physical top-three/top-four controls on identical examples.
